fictional_leak_findings.title: Dead-code fictional fallback in ScreenOrderDetail (Box Nashville / Bowl Gratiné / Frite XXL)
fictional_leak_findings.evidence: When `window.LC.orders.findById(orderId)` returns null, the component renders a hardcoded fictional 3-item list: [Box Nashville 17€, Bowl Gratiné 12€, Frite XXL 4€]. All three names violate the canonical Le Cayenne catalogue (post MENU-RESET 2026-05-13 + heal-light v2 2026-05-14).
fictional_leak_findings.reachability_analysis: Le Cayenne - Prototype.html:135 mounts ScreenOrderDetail with NO orderId param. Default param orderId='C-1234' (screens-modals.jsx:198). LC.orders.findById('C-1234') returns ORDERS_ACTIVE[0] (orders.js:25-43). Fallback path is therefore UNREACHABLE via normal navigation. Only triggerable if (a) someone manually passes a non-existent id via go('orderDetail', 'C-XXXX') or (b) LC.orders is undefined at render time.
fictional_leak_findings.real_world_risk: Low — but principle violation (anti-fiction discipline §13 evidence rules + project_massive_logic_image_cycle 2026-05-17 fictional-purge mandate).
fictional_leak_findings.recommendation: Replace fallback with role='status' empty-state: 'Détails de cette commande indisponibles. Reviens à la liste pour relancer la requête.' + back-button. Scope ~5 LOC. V1.0.2 backlog.

wizard_parity_findings.title: Per-step validation (canAdvance) gates CTA correctly
